perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Q2 FY2027 revenue of $771.8M, up 30%, Atlas growth near 29%, EA/other near 36%, and raised guidance remain the newest realized operating evidence.
September 29 Investor Day remains evidence-to-come and is not pre-counted.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Broad growth supports execution while unchanged Atlas growth versus elevated expectations is a useful expectations-risk signal; durable AI monetization remains unproven.

contradictions: Strong total growth and raised guidance coexist with investor concern that Atlas growth has not accelerated.
unknowns: Investor Day long-term targets until released
